rows.name: clique number omega <= 5
rows.detail: CAB=5 beats Delsarte=6; C(2,6)=-6<0. P(37) has omega=4. Folded in as forbid_clique=5.

rows.name: coclique number alpha <= 5
rows.detail: complement has same parameters (self-complementary); CAB=5 => alpha<=5. P(37) has alpha=4. Folded in as forbid_independent=5.

rows.name: every edge in exactly 8 triangles (lambda)
rows.detail: triangles-per-edge range on P(37) = (8, 8) (== lambda). Enforced by the common-neighbour cardinality constraint.

rows.name: neighbourhood is 8-regular on 18 vertices
rows.detail: P(37): neighbourhood sizes=(18,), local degrees=(8,). Seeds the staged neighbourhood fixing.

rows.name: each non-adjacent pair has mu=9 common neighbours (V-forms)
rows.detail: subsumed by the SRG verification; drives the mu side of the conference identity (#common + [i~j] == 9).

rows.name: A^2 = kI + lambda A + mu(J-I-A)
rows.detail: identity holds on P(37): True. Basis of the single unified per-pair cardinality constraint used by the encoder.

rows.name: p-rank invariants (2-rank, 3-rank)
rows.detail: P(37): 2-rank=36, 3-rank=18 (3-rank=18 is the classic conference invariant). Usable as a cheap fingerprint / parallel partition.

rows.name: automorphism orders in {1,2,3,9,18,666}; <=20 fixed points
rows.detail: Crnkovic-Maksimovic (2020): exactly 40 non-rigid SRG(37,18,8,9); 6726 rigid. P(37) is the unique one with |Aut|=666. Justifies pure vertex-relabel isomorph rejection for the rigid bulk.

rows.name: switching class / regular two-graph on 38 vertices
rows.detail: the 6760 known graphs are descendants of 191 regular two-graphs on 38 vertices (McKay-Spence). Alternative decomposition + completeness cross-check.

rows.name: parameters are self-complementary
rows.detail: complement of P(37) is SRG(37,18,8,9): True. Any non-complementation-symmetric invariant halves work / checks.

rows.name: SMS lexicographic canonical form + nauty filter is isomorph-free
rows.detail: validated: C5/Paley(9)/Petersen enumerations reduce to the correct unique counts via nauty dedup.

rows.name: canonical max-clique anchor makes staging disjoint
rows.detail: stage.py partitions by omega in {3,4,5} with a fixed K_t anchor; validated on Paley(9).
